lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Some bad news. A few employees got phone calls from people pretending to be from IT, asking for OTP codes.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: A new Handbook chapter is open: Passwords & MFA. Give it a read if you have time.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: You also get a new action: RESET PASSWORD. Use it for accounts that someone else has taken over.

lines.speaker: rani
lines.text: Remember this forever: an OTP is like your house key. Never give it to anyone.

lines.speaker: kelabu
lines.text: You're getting annoying. Lucky for us, your employees still love downloading files.
